notes_for_editor: Only two sources were readable and they agree on the 1952 tower and the 1938 L-4 it replaced. Staffing 'every summer' and the personnel years are undated. No rental listing or public access rule was found. Searches surfaced a 2005 geocache listing and a 2008 forum trip report; neither was used as a citation (the geocache page yielded only its title). Personnel names from firelookout.com are left out of the story. Elevation was not recorded in facts: the register gives 5,702 ft and firelookout.com gives 5,714 ft.
